card.architecture: SeedVR2 3B (ByteDance) - a one-step diffusion transformer for video/image restoration, Q8_0 GGUF, with its own video VAE
card.summary: Restore and upscale an image through SeedVR2's one-step diffusion transformer. Unlike the Anime and Photo upscalers - feed-forward networks that only resolve detail already present - SeedVR2 INVENTS plausible detail, so it can rebuild texture those nets can only smooth. That is also its risk: it can sharpen or fabricate things that were never in the source. SeedVR2 is natively a video restorer; a still is fed to it as a one-frame clip.
use_cases: rebuild texture in a soft, low-resolution or over-compressed image
clean the VAE grid / smeared micro-detail left by another generative model
push an image well past what a feed-forward upscaler can recover
card.nsfw_capable: yes - no text conditioning and no content model
card.commercial_use: open weights - verify the SeedVR2 license for your use
card.pick_when: The Anime or Photo upscaler left the image soft because the detail simply wasn't there to resolve. Prefer those two when the source is already clean: they are far faster and they never invent. Reach for SeedVR2 when you want detail reconstructed and accept that it is reconstructed.

prompt.guidance: This editor takes no prompt. SeedVR2 is a restorer, not a text-to-image model - there is no text encoder in the graph, so there is no instruction box.
prompt.instructions: Send a source image and set Scale, exactly as for the Anime and Photo upscalers. Unlike them, SeedVR2 has no fixed native factor - it is asked for a target size directly, so any scale is native. 'Colour match' controls how the output's colour is re-matched to the source; 'lab' is the default and is usually right.
do: Set Scale to the enlargement you actually want
Use it when the source lacks the detail you need recovered
dont: Expect it to be faithful the way the feed-forward upscalers are - it reconstructs
Reach for it first on an already-clean source; Anime/Photo are faster and safer

negative.note: One-step diffusion restorer; there is no text conditioning of any kind.

speed.note: One diffusion step, but the 3B weights do not fit this 8 GB card: 32 of its transformer blocks plus the IO components stream from system RAM (BlockSwap), and the VAE encodes/decodes in 512px tiles. Memory fit is bought with wall-clock.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Send an image and set Scale. No prompt is used. Slower than the Anime/Photo upscalers by a wide margin - it is a diffusion pass, not a single convolution.
ui_help.good_for: rebuilding detail that a plain upscaler cannot recover

edit_use_cases: diffusion upscale/restore of an image whose detail must be reconstructed, not merely resolved
